events.title: 🚨🧟‍♂️ THRILLER SKATE ! 🧟‍♂️🚨
events.description: Are you ready to moonwalk into the spookiest skate night of the season? 🎤🛼🎃 Join us for Thriller Skate this Saturday at Pier 2 Roller Skating Rink and celebrate the music of Michael Jackson with a night full of thrills, chills, and skating fun! 👻 Costume Contest 🎵 Michael Jackson’s Greatest Hits 🧠 Trivia & Prizes 🍕 Café & Drink Specials 🕸️ Spooky Music All Night Long 📅 Saturday, October 18 ⏰ 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM 💲 Admission: $12 🛼 Skate Rental: $8 ✅ All Ages Welcome Gather your crew, dress in your best Halloween costume, and get ready for a night that’s sure to be a thriller… and no filler! 🧟‍♀️✨
